       idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles =      minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return uint64_t r = splitmix64(state);\n    // 24-bit mantissa resolution uniform value in [0, 1)\n    return static_cast<val_t>((r >> 40) * (1.0 / 16777216.0));\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDev(const Triangle& t, uint64_t& state) {\n    val_t u = randUniform(state);\n    val_t v = randUniform(state);\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device-side visibility testing (octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDev(const Vec3& center, const Vec3& halfExtent,\n                                                      const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle,\n// using an iterative stack-based traversal of the flattened octree.\n__device__ bool isRayBlockedDev(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                                 const GpuOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                 const int* __restrict__ triIdx,\n                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,\n                                 int rootIdx, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[128];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = rootIdx;\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        int ni = stack[--sp];\n        const GpuOctreeNode& node = nodes[ni];\n\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = triIdx[node.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = triangles[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int childIdx = node.children[c];\n                if (childIdx >= 0 && rayIntersectsBoxDev(nodes[childIdx].center, nodes[childIdx].halfExtent, from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = childIdx;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CUDA Kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between all pairs of triangles (one thread per pair)\n__global__ void computeKijKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles, int numTriangles,\n                                  const GpuOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                  const int* __restrict__ triIdx, int rootIdx,\n                                  uint64_t baseSeed, val_t* __restrict__ kij) {\n    long long idx = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n\n    int i = static_cast<int>(idx / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(idx % numTriangles);\n    if (i == j) return;  // kij[i,i] stays zero\n\n    const Triangle triI = triangles[i];\n    const Triangle triJ = triangles[j];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return;\n\n    uint64_t state = baseSeed ^ (static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL) ^\n                      (static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4FULL);\n    splitmix64(state);  // mix the seed before use\n\n    val_t kijAccum = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangleDev(triI, state);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangleDev(triJ, state);\n\n        if (isRayBlockedDev(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, triangles, rootIdx, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kijAccum += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kij[idx] = kijAccum * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Compute time delays (Tau) between all pairs of triangles\n__global__ void computeTauKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles, int numTriangles,\n                                  int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    long long idx = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n\n    int i = static_cast<int>(idx / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(idx % numTriangles);\n    if (i == j) return;\n\n    val_t dist = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();\n    tau[idx] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// One timestep of wave propagation, one thread per triangle\n__global__ void simulationStepKernel(int numTriangles, size_t t,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ kij,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ tau,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ radE,\n                                      val_t* __restrict__ radB) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= numTriangles) return;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    size_t rowOff = static_cast<size_t>(i) * numTriangles;\n    for (int j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tau[rowOff + j];\n        if (t < static_cast<size_t>(tauij)) continue;\n\n        val_t kijv = kij[rowOff + j];\n        if (kijv <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        val_t radJ = radB[srcTime * numTriangles + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        val_t contrib = kijv * areas[j];\n        contrib = contrib < ONE ? contrib : ONE;\n        sumB += contrib * radJ;\n    }\n\n    size_t outIdx = t * static_cast<size_t>(numTriangles) + i;\n    radB[outIdx] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[outIdx];\n}\n\n// Cross-correlation based distance estimation, one block per triangle\n__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(int numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,\n                                        size_t sourceIndex,\n                                        const val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                                        val_t* __restrict__ distances) {\n    extern __shared__ unsigned char smemRaw[];\n    val_t* sMax = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(smemRaw);\n    int* sT = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sMax + blockDim.x);\n\n    int i = blockIdx.x;\n    if (i >= numTriangles) return;\n\n    val_t localMax = ZERO;\n    int localT = 0;\n\n    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > localMax) {\n            localMax = sum;\n            localT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    sMax[threadIdx.x] = localMax;\n    sT[threadIdx.x] = localT;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n            val_t otherMax = sMax[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            int otherT = sT[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            val_t myMax = sMax[threadIdx.x];\n            int myT = sT[threadIdx.x];\n            // Prefer strictly greater sum; on ties, prefer the smaller t (matches\n            // the sequential reference which only updates on strict improvement\n            // while scanning t in increasing order).\n            bool takeOther = (otherMax > myMax) || (otherMax == myMax && otherT < myT);\n            if (takeOther) {\n                sMax[threadIdx.x] = otherMax;\n                sT[threadIdx.x] = otherT;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(sT[0]);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (host)\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n\n    // Persistent GPU resources, allocated once and reused across phases.\n    Triangle* d_triangles = nullptr;\n    GpuOctreeNode* d_octreeNodes = nullptr;\n    int* d_octreeTriIdx = nullptr;\n    int octreeRootIdx = 0;\n    val_t* d_areas = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_rho = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_kij = nullptr;\n    int* d_tau = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radE = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radB = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_distances = nullptr;\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    std::vector<GpuOctreeNode> flatNodes;\n    std::vector<int> flatTriIdx;\n    state.octreeRootIdx = flattenOctree(state.octree, flatNodes, flatTriIdx);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // Upload static geometry / acceleration structures to the GPU\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_triangles, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_triangles, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_octreeNodes, flatNodes.size() * sizeof(GpuOctreeNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_octreeNodes, flatNodes.data(), flatNodes.size() * sizeof(GpuOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_octreeTriIdx, flatTriIdx.size() * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_octreeTriIdx, flatTriIdx.data(), flatTriIdx.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_areas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_areas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rho, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_rho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_kij, n * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_kij, 0, n * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tau, n * n * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_tau, 0, n * n * sizeof(int)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radE, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radE, state.radE.data(), timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radB, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_radB, 0, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_distances, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_distances, 0, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n}\n\nvoid freeGpuResources(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.d_triangles);\n    cudaFree(state.d_octreeNodes);\n    cudaFree(state.d_octreeTriIdx);\n    cudaFree(state.d_areas);\n    cudaFree(state.d_rho);\n    cudaFree(state.d_kij);\n    cudaFree(state.d_tau);\n    cudaFree(state.d_radE);\n    cudaFree(state.d_radB);\n    cudaFree(state.d_distances);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij) on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(n) * n;\n    const int threads = 256;\n    const long long blocks = (total + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    computeKijKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(\n        state.d_triangles, n, state.d_octreeNodes, state.d_octreeTriIdx,\n        state.octreeRootIdx, /*baseSeed=*/42ULL, state.d_kij);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.d_kij,\n                           state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),\n                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    printf(\"  Done: %zu form factor entries computed\\n\", state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles);\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau) on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(n) * n;\n    const int threads = 256;\n    const long long blocks = (total + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    computeTauKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(state.d_triangles, n, state.d_tau);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.tau.data(), state.d_tau,\n                           state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles * sizeof(int),\n                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int threads = 256;\n    const int blocks = (n + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        simulationStepKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(\n            n, t, state.d_kij, state.d_tau, state.d_areas, state.d_rho,\n            state.d_radE, state.d_radB);\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.d_radB,\n                           state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),\n                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    int threads = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(256, state.numTimesteps));\n    if (threads < 1) threads = 1;\n    size_t sharedBytes = static_cast<size_t>(threads) * (sizeof(val_t) + sizeof(int));\n\n    computeDistancesKernel<<<n, threads, sharedBytes>>>(\n        n, state.numTimesteps, state.sourceIndex, state.d_radB, state.d_distances);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.d_distances,\n                           state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } uint64_t r = splitmix64(state);\n    // 24-bit mantissa resolution uniform value in [0, 1)\n    return static_cast<val_t>((r >> 40) * (1.0 / 16777216.0));\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDev(const Triangle& t, uint64_t& state) {\n    val_t u = randUniform(state);\n    val_t v = randUniform(state);\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device-side visibility testing (octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDev(const Vec3& center, const Vec3& halfExtent,\n                                                      const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle,\n// using an iterative stack-based traversal of the flattened octree.\n__device__ bool isRayBlockedDev(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                                 const GpuOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                 const int* __restrict__ triIdx,\n                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,\n                                 int rootIdx, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[128];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = rootIdx;\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        int ni = stack[--sp];\n        const GpuOctreeNode& node = nodes[ni];\n\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = triIdx[node.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = triangles[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int childIdx = node.children[c];\n                if (childIdx >= 0 && rayIntersectsBoxDev(nodes[childIdx].center, nodes[childIdx].halfExtent, from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = childIdx;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CUDA Kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between all pairs of triangles (one thread per pair)\n__global__ void computeKijKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles, int numTriangles,\n                                  const GpuOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                  const int* __restrict__ triIdx, int rootIdx,\n                                  uint64_t baseSeed, val_t* __restrict__ kij) {\n    long long idx = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n\n    int i = static_cast<int>(idx / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(idx % numTriangles);\n    if (i == j) return;  // kij[i,i] stays zero\n\n    const Triangle triI = triangles[i];\n    const Triangle triJ = triangles[j];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return;\n\n    uint64_t state = baseSeed ^ (static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL) ^\n                      (static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4FULL);\n    splitmix64(state);  // mix the seed before use\n\n    val_t kijAccum = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangleDev(triI, state);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangleDev(triJ, state);\n\n        if (isRayBlockedDev(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, triangles, rootIdx, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kijAccum += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kij[idx] = kijAccum * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Compute time delays (Tau) between all pairs of triangles\n__global__ void computeTauKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles, int numTriangles,\n                                  int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    long long idx = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n\n    int i = static_cast<int>(idx / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(idx % numTriangles);\n    if (i == j) return;\n\n    val_t dist = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();\n    tau[idx] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// One timestep of wave propagation, one thread per triangle\n__global__ void simulationStepKernel(int numTriangles, size_t t,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ kij,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ tau,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n                                      const val_t* __restrict__ radE,\n                                      val_t* __restrict__ radB) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= numTriangles) return;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    size_t rowOff = static_cast<size_t>(i) * numTriangles;\n    for (int j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tau[rowOff + j];\n        if (t < static_cast<size_t>(tauij)) continue;\n\n        val_t kijv = kij[rowOff + j];\n        if (kijv <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        val_t radJ = radB[srcTime * numTriangles + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        val_t contrib = kijv * areas[j];\n        contrib = contrib < ONE ? contrib : ONE;\n        sumB += contrib * radJ;\n    }\n\n    size_t outIdx = t * static_cast<size_t>(numTriangles) + i;\n    radB[outIdx] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[outIdx];\n}\n\n// Cross-correlation based distance estimation, one block per triangle\n__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(int numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,\n                                        size_t sourceIndex,\n                                        const val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                                        val_t* __restrict__ distances) {\n    extern __shared__ unsigned char smemRaw[];\n    val_t* sMax = reinterpret_cast<val_t*>(smemRaw);\n    int* sT = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sMax + blockDim.x);\n\n    int i = blockIdx.x;\n    if (i >= numTriangles) return;\n\n    val_t localMax = ZERO;\n    int localT = 0;\n\n    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numTimesteps; t += blockDim.x) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[tt * numTriangles + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > localMax) {\n            localMax = sum;\n            localT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    sMax[threadIdx.x] = localMax;\n    sT[threadIdx.x] = localT;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n            val_t otherMax = sMax[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            int otherT = sT[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            val_t myMax = sMax[threadIdx.x];\n            int myT = sT[threadIdx.x];\n            // Prefer strictly greater sum; on ties, prefer the smaller t (matches\n            // the sequential reference which only updates on strict improvement\n            // while scanning t in increasing order).\n            bool takeOther = (otherMax > myMax) || (otherMax == myMax && otherT < myT);\n            if (takeOther) {\n                sMax[threadIdx.x] = otherMax;\n                sT[threadIdx.x] = otherT;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(sT[0]);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (host)\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n\n    // Persistent GPU resources, allocated once and reused across phases.\n    Triangle* d_triangles = nullptr;\n    GpuOctreeNode* d_octreeNodes = nullptr;\n    int* d_octreeTriIdx = nullptr;\n    int octreeRootIdx = 0;\n    val_t* d_areas = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_rho = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_kij = nullptr;\n    int* d_tau = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radE = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radB = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_distances = nullptr;\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    std::vector<GpuOctreeNode> flatNodes;\n    std::vector<int> flatTriIdx;\n    state.octreeRootIdx = flattenOctree(state.octree, flatNodes, flatTriIdx);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // Upload static geometry / acceleration structures to the GPU\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_triangles, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_triangles, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_octreeNodes, flatNodes.size() * sizeof(GpuOctreeNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_octreeNodes, flatNodes.data(), flatNodes.size() * sizeof(GpuOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_octreeTriIdx, flatTriIdx.size() * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_octreeTriIdx, flatTriIdx.data(), flatTriIdx.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_areas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_areas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rho, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_rho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_kij, n * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_kij, 0, n * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tau, n * n * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_tau, 0, n * n * sizeof(int)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radE, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radE, state.radE.data(), timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radB, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_radB, 0, timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_distances, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_distances, 0, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n}\n\nvoid freeGpuResources(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.d_triangles);\n    cudaFree(state.d_octreeNodes);\n    cudaFree(state.d_octreeTriIdx);\n    cudaFree(state.d_areas);\n    cudaFree(state.d_rho);\n    cudaFree(state.d_kij);\n    cudaFree(state.d_tau);\n    cudaFree(state.d_radE);\n    cudaFree(state.d_radB);\n    cudaFree(state.d_distances);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij) on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(n) * n;\n    const int threads = 256;\n    const long long blocks = (total + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    computeKijKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(\n        state.d_triangles, n, state.d_octreeNodes, state.d_octreeTriIdx,\n        state.octreeRootIdx, /*baseSeed=*/42ULL, state.d_kij);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.d_kij,\n                           state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),\n                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    printf(\"  Done: %zu form factor entries computed\\n\", state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles);\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau) on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(n) * n;\n    const int threads = 256;\n    const long long blocks = (total + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    computeTauKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(state.d_triangles, n, state.d_tau);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.tau.data(), state.d_tau,\n                           state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles * sizeof(int),\n                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int threads = 256;\n    const int blocks = (n + threads - 1) / threads;\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        simulationStepKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(\n            n, t, state.d_kij, state.d_tau, state.d_areas, state.d_rho,\n            state.d_radE, state.d_radB);\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.d_radB,\n                           state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),\n                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    int threads = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(256, state.numTimesteps));\n    if (threads < 1) threads = 1;\n    size_t sharedBytes = static_cast<size_t>(threads) * (sizeof(val_t) + sizeof(int));\n\n    computeDistancesKernel<<<n, threads, sharedBytes>>>(\n        n, state.numTimesteps, state.sourceIndex, state.d_radB, state.d_distances);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.d_distances,\n                           state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } Room Response Simulation Benchmark\n * \n * This is a simplified, purely sequential implementation of room impulse response\n * simulation using radiosity-based wave propagation. It models how sound/light\n * waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:\n * \n * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry\n * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)\n * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values\n * \n * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.\n */\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <array>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <map>\n#include <memory>\n#include <random>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Types and Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\nusing idx_t = uint32_t;\nusing val_t = float;\n\nconstexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;\nconstexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;\nconstexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;\nconstexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)\nconstexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;\nconstexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling\nconstexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;\nconstexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Vector and Triangle Types\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    val_t x, y, z;\n\n    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}\n\n    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }\n    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }\n    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n\n    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n    }\n\n    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }\n    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }\n    Vec3 normalized() const {\n        val_t n = norm();\n        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;\n    }\n};\n\nstruct Triangle {\n    Vec3 a, b, c;\n    Vec3 _normal;\n\n    Triangle() = default;\n    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)\n        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}\n\n    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n\n    val_t area() const {\n        Vec3 ab = b - a;\n        Vec3 ac = c - a;\n        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n
